description: This file defines the CapabilitiesClient class, which provides methods to fetch capabilities and user display name from a server using an API provider, specifically for the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: CapabilitiesClient
classes.description: A utility class for fetching capabilities and user display name from the server.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Fetches capabilities from the server, updates local repository, and returns the capabilities object.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Retrieves the display name of the user associated with the given SSO account.
